query: 供应商申诉机制 供应商申诉机制 衡量企业为供应商提供的正式沟通与举报渠道。重点考察申诉渠道的独立性、匿名保护能力、反报复政策、处理时限以及重大争议的升级处理机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：设有独立的第三方举报平台或由审计/合规部门直管的匿名渠道；具备书面的《供应商反报复政策》；明确了申诉处理的时限（如 15 个工作日内给予实质性答复）；并有高级管理层参与的争议调解与升级路径。 • 1分（合格）：提供了采购部门外的申诉联系方式（如廉洁邮箱、热线），有基础的受理与记录流程，但缺乏第三方独立性、具体的处理时限承诺或系统性的反报复保护细则。 • 0分（不合格）：无针对供应商的正式申诉渠道披露，或仅提供采购员个人联系方式。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：申诉机制覆盖 >80% 的供应商（按采购额或数量计），且在供应商系统（SRM）、合同附件或年度供应商大会中进行了明确告知。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心供应商知晓该渠道，或未披露具体告知与覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商申诉机制 供应商举报 供应商诉说渠道 供应商反报复 采购廉洁热线 供应商争议升级 SRM supplier grievance mechanism supplier whistleblowing supplier speak-up anti-retaliation for suppliers procurement integrity hotline supplier dispute escalation SRM 供应商可用的正式申诉/举报渠道有哪些？ 是否独立于采购员个人联系方式并支持匿名？ 是否有书面反报复政策与处理时限？ 重大争议如何升级到高层？ 机制覆盖多少供应商，是否告知供应商？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商申诉机制'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 供应商可用的正式申诉/举报渠道有哪些？ 是否独立于采购员个人联系方式并支持匿名？ 是否有书面反报复政策与处理时限？ 重大争议如何升级到高层？ 机制覆盖多少供应商，是否告知供应商？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工申诉热线；仅有采购员微信/电话；仅有供应商行为准则而无申诉入口；仅有客户投诉渠道；区分：供应商申诉机制服务供应商；员工申诉服务员工；举报人保护偏内部舞弊举报；有行为准则不等于已建立供应商可及申诉渠道。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The major suppliers of the Group are terminal machinery, components, oils and lubricants suppliers and ferry owners. Under the principles of 'transparency, fairness, impartiality and honesty', the Group has established a comprehensive tendering evaluation system and set up stringent supplier screening procedures in the Management Measures for Tendering and Bidding and the Procedures of Procurement Management, regulating the management of different types of suppliers of the Group. A total of 234 suppliers were covered in the evaluation during the Reporting Period. The Group's Technical Support Department works closely together with relevant departments to identify suitable suppliers and to assess their qualifications and performance. At least three potential suppliers would be invited for tendering for the Group to choose the right suppliers.

Quality and Reliable Service / Valuing Customer Privacy and Persistence in Information Accuracy

[Content]
The major suppliers of the Group are terminal machinery, components, oils and lubricants suppliers and ferry owners. Under the principles of 'transparency, fairness, impartiality and honesty', the Group has established a comprehensive tendering evaluation system and set up stringent supplier screening procedures in the Management Measures for Tendering and Bidding and the Procedures of Procurement Management, regulating the management of different types of suppliers of the Group. A total of 234 suppliers were covered in the evaluation during the Reporting Period. The Group's Technical Support Department works closely together with relevant departments to identify suitable suppliers and to assess their qualifications and performance. At least three potential suppliers would be invited for tendering for the Group to choose the right suppliers.

results.text: Significant ESG risks | Potential Impacts | Response Approaches The Group will also assess the supplier's performance in a number of ESG areas, such as product and service quality, ethical conduct and environmental protection. Sun Ferry has set out its ESG requirements for suppliers in the Supplier Code and favours suppliers who demonstrate a commitment to the principles outlined in the Code in the supplier selection process. To verify that our suppliers meet our requirements and drive improvements, we assess the performance of our existing key suppliers annually against the criteria and procedures specified in the Comprehensive Supplier Evaluation Management Scheme. results.text: The Group established the Whistle-blowing Policy to support the identification and report of any suspicious cases of unethical business conduct or misbehaviour have developed a whistle-blowing system along with the policy to provide a channel for employees and business partners to report or submit a grievance on any misconduct malpractices. All relevant information will be treated in a confidential manner to protect whistle-blowers. Personal details of the whistle-blowers are anonymous to safeguard their rights and personal safety. [Section]
Approach to Sustainability / Preventing Illegal Acts

[Content]
The Group established the Whistle-blowing Policy to support the identification and report of any suspicious cases of unethical business conduct or misbehaviour have developed a whistle-blowing system along with the policy to provide a channel for employees and business partners to report or submit a grievance on any misconduct malpractices. All relevant information will be treated in a confidential manner to protect whistle-blowers. Personal details of the whistle-blowers are anonymous to safeguard their rights and personal safety. All complaints and reports will undergo a thorough and fair investigation. During the Reporting Period, there was no legal case regarding corrupt practices were brought against the Group or our employees.

results.text: The Group has been trying to incorporate the sustainable practice into its supply chain management. We seek to work with suppliers who share the same value with us. Apart from evaluating the cost, reputation and delivery of potential suppliers' products and services, the Group also considers their social and environmental performances, such as product and service quality, ethical conduct and environmental conservation. The Group has been trying to incorporate the sustainable practice into its supply chain management. We seek to work with suppliers who share the same value with us. Taking Sun Ferry as an example, Sun Ferry has stipulated its ESG requirements for suppliers in a Supplier Code of Conduct , and favours suppliers who could demonstrate commitments to uphold sustainability principles listed in the code during suppliers' selection process.
